# Security & Lifecycle Requirements Checklist: Temporary Room Owner Permissions

**Purpose**: Formal security and design-review checklist for the completeness, clarity, consistency,
and testability of temporary-room owner permission requirements.
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the two native room-management permissions and their intended capability boundaries explicitly specified for the owner-only allowance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002; Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 Are all prohibited owner capabilities explicitly enumerated, including Administrator, server roles, server management, moderation, and unrelated server-wide privileges? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Does the specification define the bot Administrator prerequisite as a distinct bot deployment requirement rather than an owner permission grant? [Completeness, Plan §Summary; Contract §Permission and Deployment]
- [x] CHK004 Is an exception owner, risk acceptance, remediation plan, and expiry defined for the bot Administrator prerequisite required by the constitution? [Gap, Constitution §Engineering Standards; Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK005 Are the requirements explicit about owner-permission state after provider outcomes of success, missing room, and failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-013; Contract §Creation and Failure]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for reapplying the owner allowance after category restoration when category synchronization changes room permissions? [Completeness, Contract §Restoration and Reconciliation]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Is the term “room owner” consistently defined as exactly one member for one current transient association, without implying persistence or transfer? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001 and §FR-011; Data Model §Transient Managed-Room Association]
- [x] CHK008 Is “room-scoped” defined consistently across requirements, data model, and contract as a member-specific overwrite on only the associated voice room? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 and §FR-005; Data Model §Channel-Scoped Owner Allowance; Contract §Discord Boundary]
- [x] CHK009 Are the terms “effective authority,” “effective Administrator,” and “lifecycle access” sufficiently defined to distinguish the bot prerequisite from prohibited owner authority? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007 and §FR-016; Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK010 Do the requirements consistently distinguish native channel settings management from native channel permission editing and describe the grouped Discord capabilities that result? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 and §FR-015; Research §Grant `ManageChannels` and `ManageRoles`]
- [x] CHK011 Is the phrase “where Discord permits” bounded so reviewers can determine which owner operations are intentionally not guaranteed? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1 and §FR-002; Contract §Permission and Deployment]
- [x] CHK012 Are the association-retention rules after allowance failure, restoration failure, and confirmed deletion mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009–FR-013 and §Edge Cases; Data Model §Parent-Restoration State Transition]

## Isolation and Security Boundary Coverage

- [x] CHK013 Are requirements specified for preventing an owner allowance from appearing on another temporary room, including replacement rooms and concurrent creations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005–FR-006 and §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are the configured trigger channel, temporary-room category, permanent channels, and unrelated channels each explicitly covered by the no-equivalent-authority boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005 and §FR-017]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements explicit that neither creation nor reconciliation can infer or reconstruct owner authority for untracked/zombie rooms? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010a–FR-011; Data Model §Transient Managed-Room Association]
- [x] CHK016 Does the specification state how existing server-level permissions that independently grant broader authority are treated outside Voicelet’s ownership model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004; Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the case in which an owner’s pre-existing server permissions exceed the new room-scoped allowance, so feature isolation claims are not misleading? [Gap, Spec §FR-003–FR-005; Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK018 Is the security trade-off of requiring bot Administrator documented consistently with the project’s least-privilege principle and prior no-Administrator guidance? [Conflict, Constitution §VI; Plan §Constitution Check; Plan §Complexity Tracking]

## Lifecycle, Restoration, and Recovery Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are the requirements clear that an owner-initiated ordinary setting change does not alter known-room lifecycle ownership or inactivity handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK020 Are the moved-room requirements complete for detection, restoration target, association retention, restoration failure, room disappearance, and owner-allowance reapplication? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010–FR-010a and §Edge Cases; Contract §Restoration and Reconciliation]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements clear that reconciliation skips a moved tracked room while restoration is pending and never expands candidate discovery outside the configured category? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a; Data Model §Parent-Restoration State Transition]
- [x] CHK022 Are the requirements consistent about when external deletion clears an owner association and enables replacement room creation, regardless of whether deletion was by the owner or an administrator? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2 and §FR-009; Contract §Creation and Failure]
- [x] CHK023 Are duplicate parent-change notifications and concurrent restoration/deletion events addressed with explicit conflict-resolution requirements? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [x] CHK024 Are ownership and reconciliation boundaries after restart or transient state loss stated consistently for both previously managed rooms and zombie rooms? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011 and §Assumptions; Data Model §Transient Managed-Room Association]

## Failure, Observability, and Acceptance-Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK025 Are allowance and restoration failure requirements explicit about continued worker availability, association retention, no duplicate creation, and bounded privacy-safe observations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-014 and §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK026 Is the set of permitted observation outcome categories sufficiently specified without requiring Discord IDs, names, raw event payloads, provider errors, or tokens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014; Contract §Permission and Deployment]
- [x] CHK027 Are retry semantics unambiguous: no automatic owner-allowance retry is introduced, while any future supported retry must be idempotent and non-duplicating? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013; Research §Contain permission setup failures]
- [x] CHK028 Do the measurable success criteria define objective evidence for owner-only capability, absence of global privileges, failure containment, deletion/recreation, and documentation readiness? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001–SC-006]
- [x] CHK029 Are the stated unit, integration, and simulated end-to-end evidence requirements traceable to every security, isolation, restoration, and failure scenario in the feature requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-018; Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [x] CHK030 Are documentation requirements complete for both the owner’s native authority and the administrator’s bot-permission prerequisite, including the risks of channel permission editing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015–FR-017; Quickstart §Prerequisites]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, exception approval, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- This checklist is for security/design reviewers at PR and release-gate time; it tests the writing and completeness of requirements, not the implementation.
